info.name: Quran App — Flutter Mobile API
info.description:
Every endpoint the Flutter app may use. All of them are PUBLIC: the backend has no end-user accounts, so there is no login, registration, profile, token, server-side favourites/bookmarks, settings or daily-wird (khatma) API. The web app keeps those on the device (localStorage); the Flutter app should keep them locally too (e.g. shared_preferences / a local DB).

The only authentication in the backend is for the admin dashboard (an httpOnly cookie under /admin/*). It is deliberately excluded from this collection and must not be used by the app.

Set `baseUrl` (collection variable) to the API origin, e.g. `http://localhost:3001` (default port). There is NO `/api` prefix. From an Android emulator use `http://10.0.2.2:3001`; from a real phone use the computer's LAN IP.

Conventions: JSON UTF-8 (Arabic is returned as plain UTF-8, no escaping needed). On endpoints that declare query parameters / a body, any unknown parameter or field = 400 (endpoints without parameters ignore extras). Integers in query strings must be plain digits. Every error uses one shape: `{ statusCode, error, message, details?, requestId, path, timestamp }` (`timestamp` = ISO-8601 UTC). Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header.

Rate limits per client IP (default server config, can be changed by env): 100 requests/min on every route, plus 30/min on /search and 10/min on /export/pdf. Over the limit: 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

Response examples in this collection were written from the backend source code with real database values; they are not recordings of live responses.

See FLUTTER-API-GUIDE.md next to this file.

item.name: 04 - Quran search
item.description: Smart Quran search (typo-tolerant, references like 2:255, voice mode). Public. `/search` has its own rate limit: 30 requests/minute per IP (429 + `Retry-After` when exceeded). Both endpoints answer 503 for a few seconds after the server starts (index building; see /health `searchReady`).

query.description: Required. Non-blank, ≤ 200 characters and ≤ 20 words. Arabic text, a reference (`2:255`, `البقرة 255`, `سورة الكهف`) or a sura name. Send UTF-8 percent-encoded (Dart `Uri` does this).

request.description:
Public. Response:
- `query`: `{ raw, normalized, alternatives?, selected? }` (the last two only for voice).
- `corrected`: null, or `{ applied: true, text, changes: [{ from, to, kind }] }` when misspelled words were corrected automatically — show "searched for X instead of Y".
- `didYouMean`: null or up to 3 suggested queries (when nothing matched and nothing was corrected).
- `reference`: null, or `{ status: "ok", ref: { kind: "ayah", sura, ayah } | { kind: "sura", sura, explicit }, ambiguous }`, or `{ status: "invalid", reason: "sura_out_of_range" | "ayah_out_of_range", sura, ayah?, ayahCount?, ambiguous }` (then there are no results).
- `total`, `page`, `limit`, `totalPages`.
- `results[]`: `{ ayahId, suraNumber, suraName, ayahNumber, ref ("sura:ayah"), textUthmani, matchType, score, confidence, highlights: [{ start, end }] }`.
`matchType`: reference | phrase | ordered | all_terms | corrected | partial | loose. `confidence`: high | medium | low (when the first result is `low`, prefer showing the top 3 as suggestions).
`highlights` are UTF-16 code-unit ranges into `textUthmani` (`end` exclusive). Dart `String` indexes are UTF-16 too, so `text.substring(start, end)` works directly.

request.description: Public. Voice mode: wider typo tolerance, merges words split by speech recognition, completes a cut-off last word. Each transcript is searched and the hits are merged. Response adds `query.alternatives` and `query.selected` (the transcript that produced the first result).

query.description: Required. Same limits as `q` of /search. Any other parameter = 400.

request.description: Public. Up to 5 completions/corrections of the LAST word: `{ query: { raw, normalized }, suggestions: [{ text, word, kind }] }`. `text` = the whole query with its last word completed; `kind`: exact | prefix | phonetic | edit1 | edit2 | skeleton | merge | split. Debounce on the client (~200 ms). Only the global rate limit (100/min/IP) applies.

item.name: 05 - Quran recitation audio
item.description:
Public. Two independent catalogues:
1. Verse-by-verse reciters (`/quran-audio/reciters`, `/ayah`, `/surah`): one MP3 per ayah.
2. Full-sura reciters (`/quran-audio/full-surah-reciters`, `/full-surah`): one MP3 per sura. A different list — do not mix identifiers between the two.
All audio `url`s returned here are ABSOLUTE `https://cdn.islamic.network/...` URLs (third-party CDN): play them as is, do not prefix the API base URL. Default reciter when `reciter` is omitted: the backend default (`ar.alafasy` when available).

request.description: Public. `{ data: [{ identifier, name, englishName, language, format, type, bitrate }], defaultReciter, source: "database" | "live" }`. `bitrate` may be null.

response.name: 200 OK (shape example, 1 shown)

Try `fallbackUrls` (same recording, other bitrates) in order if `url` fails. 404 when the ayah has no recording. `surahNumber` 1..114, `ayahNumber` 1..286 (the real per-sura limit is checked: 404).

No per-ayah timing is available inside this file.

item.name: 06 - Adhkar
item.description:
Adhkar (Hisn al-Muslim): 132 categories, 267 items. Public, read-only, no pagination.
An item is identified by `(categoryId, number)` — `number` restarts at 1 in every category. Use that pair (not any other id) as a stable key, e.g. for favourites stored on the device.
`text` is the supplication EXACTLY as stored (diacritics, brackets, punctuation): display it unchanged, right-to-left.
`audioUrl` is a RELATIVE path such as `/adhkar/audio/75.mp3`, or null when there is no recording. Build the playable URL as `baseUrl + audioUrl` (see "Audio file" request).
Morning and evening adhkar are ONE category (id 1, «أذكار الصباح والمساء»).

request.description: Public. `{ data: [{ id, title, order, itemCount, audioUrl }] }` in display order (`order`). `audioUrl` = whole-category recording (relative) or null.

response.name: 200 OK (shape example, 2 of 132 shown)

originalRequest.description: Public. `{ data: [{ id, title, order, itemCount, audioUrl }] }` in display order (`order`). `audioUrl` = whole-category recording (relative) or null.

request.description: Public. `{ category: { id, title, order, itemCount, audioUrl }, items: [{ categoryId, number, order, text, repeatCount, audioUrl }] }`, items in display order. `repeatCount` = how many times the dhikr is said (≥ 1). 404 for an unknown category. The test script saves the first item's audio file name into `adhkarAudioFile`.

The test script saves the first item's audio file name into `adhkarAudioFile`.

Public. `{ data: [{ key, label, categoryId, categoryTitle, defaultTime, message }] }`. `key`: morning | evening | sleep | wake. `defaultTime` = local time "HH:MM" (24 h) suggestion; the backend does NOT schedule or send notifications — schedule local notifications on the device (e.g. flutter_local_notifications) and open `categoryId` when tapped.

request.description: Public. Returns the MP3 bytes (`Content-Type: audio/mpeg`). This is the URL behind every `audioUrl` (`baseUrl + audioUrl`). Supports HTTP Range (seeking/streaming) and ETag; cached for 30 days (`Cache-Control: public, max-age=2592000, immutable`). 404 for any file name that is not referenced by the adhkar data. Postman shows binary — use "Send and Download" to save it.

item.name: 07 - PDF export
item.description: Public. Rate limit: 10 requests/minute per IP.

item.name: Export ayahs (+ optional tafsir) as PDF

request.description:
Public. Body `{ items: [{ ayahId, tafsirBookId? }] }`, 1 to 100 items, in the order to print. `tafsirBookId` optional (omit = ayah only); it must be a visible book (see /tafsir-books) else 400. Unknown fields = 400.
Response: 200 `application/pdf` (attachment, filename `quran-selection.pdf`), RTL A4 booklet. Save the bytes to a file and open/share it.
Errors: 400 invalid body / hidden or unknown tafsir book; 404 unknown ayah; 429 rate limit; 503 when the server has no Chrome/Chromium available.
